body.resource_hint: For f(x)=integral_0^1 exp(i*x*t)dt and d(x,y)=integral_{0<t2<t1<1} exp(i*y*t1+i*(x-y)*t2)dt1dt2, the normalized interference kernel is k(x,y)=Im(conj(f(x))*d(x,y))/abs(f(x))^2. It equals [1-cos((y-x)/2)*sinc(y/2)/sinc(x/2)]/(y-x), reduces to 1/y-sin(y)/y^2 at x=0, and differs from that diagonal kernel by at most (32/5)*abs(x)/y^2 for abs(x)<=1/2 and abs(y)>=1. The ultraviolet divergence is therefore the same local diagonal term; the difference is absolutely integrable on compact external support.
